identityComparison.implementation: Explicit comparison of installationId, clusterId, kubeSystemUid, environmentId, volumeId and pvcUid; null registered identity is rejected.
identityComparison.reason: Existing input and view builders already constructed the same six fields in fixed order. The change removes the serialization dependency rather than claiming a reproduced JSONB bug at this call site.

limitations: The A/B VMs and Mac backup copies share one physical Mac. This is not physical off-host or cloud disaster-recovery acceptance.
Business acceptance uses small synthetic persistent markers, not a production-size throughput or recovery-time guarantee.
Redis real acceptance selected a permanent string marker; expiration semantics and malformed clocks/TTL remain covered by the local protocol suite.
The product manual-record API persists operator evidence and does not claim independent platform verification.
Recovery re-entry and failed/unknown-import refusal are covered by journal tests. No failed real import was forced and no real import was replayed.
Existing public-image cache assistance remains part of the local-lab environment; this does not claim unassisted registry access.
